translation.name: Telepathy
profile: Telepathy creates a connection for short sentences and simple images between the caster and one willing creature they know. It can help when the party splits up over a short distance or cooperates silently. This is deliberately shared communication rather than unlimited access to the other person's memories, secrets, and unsent thoughts.

The target must be within sight at the start, and the connection has a limited range and duration. Only one such connection exists, so it is not an automatic network for every member of the expedition. In a story, it is useful to agree on brief messages and a plan in advance. The spell makes cooperation easier but does not supply information the participants do not themselves know.

Exact effect: Allows two-way transmission of short sentences and simple images. Does not read thoughts that are not sent. Target: 1 willing, known creature within 100 m. Duration: 10 minutes. Restrictions: 1 connection; the target must be within sight at the start. Using it requires at least Intelligence 8 and Level 2, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

Target, duration, restrictions, and exact effect.
strings.Min. CH a Min. Level pouze dovolují kouz: Min. INT and Min. Level only allow a spell to be learned. The character must actually acquire it through leveling, a teacher, a book, a scroll, a reward, a discovery, or the story.
strings.Vytvoří neškodné světlo o dosahu přibliž: Creates harmless light with a range of about 5 m. The caster can turn it off at any time.
strings.bod nebo předmět na dosah: a point or object within reach
strings.Zapálí malý připravený zdroj ohně. Nezpů: Ignites a small, prepared source of fire. Deals no damage and cannot ignite wet material.
strings.nelze cílit na tvora ani nesený předmět: cannot target a creature or a carried item
strings.svíčka, pochodeň nebo suchý troud na doh: a candle, torch, or dry tinder within sight
strings.Vytvoří jednoduchý zvuk dlouhý nejvýše 6: Creates a simple sound lasting no more than 6 seconds. Cannot imitate the intelligible speech of a specific person.
strings.Odstraní běžnou špínu, bláto, prach nebo: Removes ordinary dirt, mud, dust, or odors without damaging the item.
strings.neodstraňuje jed, kletbu ani poškození: does not remove poison, curses, or damage
strings.předmět nebo plocha do 1 m²: an item or an area of up to 1 m²
strings.Ukáže směr k nejbližšímu dosažitelnému z: Shows the direction of the nearest reachable water source within 1 km. Does not determine whether the water is safe to drink.
strings.1 ruka; bez útoku a složité jemné práce: 1 hand; no attacks or complex fine work
strings.Vytvoří viditelnou magickou ruku, která: Creates a visible magical hand that can lift, carry, or set down an item, or press a simple mechanism. This is not Telekinesis and cannot affect a creature.
strings.volný předmět do 2 kg a 5 m: an unattached item up to 2 kg within 5 m
strings.1 nemagický předmět do velikosti batohu: 1 nonmagical item no larger than a backpack
strings.1× na stejné poškození; musí být přítomn: once per instance of damage; all parts must be present
strings.Spojí prasklinu, přetržený řemínek nebo: Mends a crack, a broken strap, or a small broken component. Does not restore consumed contents or magic.
strings.1 předmět, tvor nebo prostor do 5 m: 1 item, creature, or area within 5 m
strings.Odhalí přítomnost magie a její nejbližší: Detects the presence of magic and its closest school. Does not reveal its exact effect, trigger, or how to dispel it.
strings.Provede zkoušku CH proti 7/9/11 podle kv: Makes an INT check against 7/9/11 depending on the lock's quality. Success opens the lock; it does not dispel a magical lock or disarm a trap.
strings.2× za souboj; nesčítá se s jiným magický: twice per combat; does not stack with another magical bonus to the same defense
strings.Cíl získá +1 k FO i MO proti jednomu pří: The target gains +1 to both PDEF and MDEF against the next attack.
strings.do příštího útoku proti cíli, nejdéle 1: until the next attack against the target, at most 1 round
strings.Proveď magický útok. Zranění se vypočte: Make a magical attack. Damage is calculated using the standard formula against the target's MDEF.
strings.Přímý jednobodový magický útok ohněm pro: A direct, single-target magical fire attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.Silnější útok vyvážený nutností dotyku;: A stronger attack balanced by requiring touch; damage is determined against MDEF.
strings.sesilatel musí stát těsně u cíle: the caster must stand immediately beside the target
strings.Útoky vedené skrz clonu mají −2 k výsled: Attacks made through the screen take −2 to their final PATK or MATK. The penalty applies to both sides.
strings.Cíl ignoruje běžné horko a získá +3 MO p: The target ignores ordinary heat and gains +3 MDEF only against fire spells and magical heat.
strings.1× za souboj; nesčítá se: once per combat; does not stack
strings.Cíl získá +2 FO pouze proti útokům zblíz: The target gains +2 PDEF only against melee attacks. The shield itself does not damage the attacker.
strings.Silný jednobodový útok; zranění se vypoč: A powerful single-target attack; damage is calculated using the standard formula against MDEF.
strings.1× za souboj; platí společné plošné prav: once per combat; the shared area-attack rule applies
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná zvlášť s MO každ: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. The bonus is already reduced relative to a comparable single-target spell.
strings.Při vzniku zasáhne nejvýše 3 cíle v lini: When created, it hits at most 3 targets in a line using the area-attack rule. The wall then blocks sight and normal passage, but deals no further damage.
strings.linie do 5 m; nejvýše 3 cíle při vzniku: a line up to 5 m long; at most 3 targets when created
strings.1× za dobrodružství; platí plošné pravid: once per adventure; the area-attack rule applies
strings.Velmi silný plošný ohnivý útok. Jeden ho: A very powerful area fire attack. One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF.
strings.Vytvoří čistou pitnou vodu v připravené: Creates clean drinking water in a prepared container. Does not create a pressurized stream or ice.
strings.Při zranění alespoň 1 Ž navíc odstrčí bě: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, it also pushes an ordinary target back a short step. A large or main opponent is not moved.
strings.posunutí nejvýše 1× na stejný cíl za kol: at most 1 push per target per round
strings.Přímý ledový útok; zranění se vypočte pr: A direct ice attack; damage is calculated against the target's MDEF.
strings.Při zranění alespoň 1 Ž má cíl navíc −1: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, the target also takes −1 to its next PATK. The penalty does not stack.
strings.do konce příštího tahu cíle: until the end of the target's next turn
strings.Cíl se může pohybovat po klidné vodní hl: The target can move across calm water as if it were solid ground. A strong wave may require an AGI check.
strings.Cíl může normálně dýchat pod vodou. Kouz: The target can breathe normally underwater. The spell grants no extra speed, vision, or resistance to pressure.
The target gains +2 PDEF against physical attacks.
strings.1× na stejný cíl za souboj; platí pravid: once per target per combat; the main-opponent rule applies
strings.Při úspěchu je běžný cíl přimražen k mís: On success, an ordinary target is frozen in place and cannot move; it can still act within reach. A main opponent instead takes −2 to its next movement check.
strings.Vytvoří překážku s 10 Ž a FO 12, která b: Creates an obstacle with 10 HP and PDEF 12 that blocks movement and sight. When the effect ends, it melts without causing a dangerous flood.
strings.nezvyšuje FO ani MO; zeď má FO 12: does not increase PDEF or MDEF; the wall has PDEF 12
strings.volná linie do 4 m: an unobstructed line up to 4 m long
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná zvlášť s MO každ: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. A hit target also takes −1 to its next movement check.
strings.Předmět do 5 kg odfoukne o několik metrů: Blows an item up to 5 kg a few meters away. Against a creature, make a MATK attack against MDEF; an ordinary target moves a short step, but a large or main opponent does not.
strings.lehký předmět nebo 1 cíl do 10 m: a light item or 1 target within 10 m
strings.Zruší zranění z pádu do 10 m a dovolí be: Negates damage from a fall of up to 10 m and allows a safe landing. Does not stop another attack or a falling item.
strings.nezvyšuje FO ani MO: does not increase PDEF or MDEF
A direct lightning attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.1× za souboj; pouze proti střelám; nesčí: once per combat; only against projectiles; does not stack
strings.Cíl získá +2 FO proti fyzickým útokům na: The target gains +2 PDEF against ranged physical attacks. Provides no protection against melee combat or spells.
strings.+0 k MÚ proti neochotnému cíli: +0 to MATK against an unwilling target
strings.1 tvor nebo předmět do 100 kg a 10 m: 1 creature or item up to 100 kg within 10 m
strings.1× za scénu; hlavní protivník neztratí a: once per scene; a main opponent does not lose its action
strings.Cíl se zvedne nejvýše 3 m a může se poma: The target rises at most 3 m and can move slowly vertically. An unwilling creature resists with MDEF. A main opponent is not lifted and instead has half movement until the end of its next turn.
strings.Silný jednobodový bleskový útok proti MO: A powerful single-target lightning attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.+0 k MÚ u drženého předmětu: +0 to MATK for a held item
strings.1× za scénu; výchozí i cílové místo musí: once per scene; both origin and destination must be within sight and 20 m
Transfers an unattached item to an empty location. A held item requires MATK against the holder's MDEF; a main opponent's item cannot be taken.
strings.nemagický předmět do 5 kg: a nonmagical item up to 5 kg
strings.3 kola v souboji nebo 10 minut mimo něj: 3 rounds in combat or 10 minutes outside combat
strings.Cíl létá přibližně rychlostí běhu. Po sk: The target flies at approximately running speed. When the effect ends, it safely descends at most 3 m; from a greater height it needs Feather Fall.
strings.sesilatel nebo 1 ochotný tvor na dosah: caster or 1 willing creature within reach
strings.1× za souboj; platí plošné pravidlo: once per combat; the area-attack rule applies
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná zvlášť s MO každ: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF.
strings.nejvýše 3 cíle, každý do několika metrů: at most 3 targets, each within a few meters of the previous one
strings.1× za souboj; cílové prázdné místo musí: once per combat; the empty destination must be within sight and 30 m
Transfers the target to a visible, safe location. Cannot enter an unknown space or travel between worlds.
strings.Vytvaruje malý kus nemagického kamene do: Shapes a small piece of nonmagical stone into a simple form. Cannot create a precise key, a weapon, or a gemstone.
strings.kámen do velikosti dlaně: a stone no larger than a palm
strings.Cíl nelze běžným odstrčením srazit ani p: Ordinary pushes cannot knock the target down or move it. It can still move on its own, and a powerful narrative effect may require a STR check.
strings.1 cíl stojící na zemi a na dohled: 1 target standing on the ground within sight
A direct earth attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.nefunguje ve vzduchu ani na palubě bez k: does not work in the air or on a deck without stone or soil
strings.Vytvoří jednoduchý otvor, schod, žlábek: Creates a simple opening, step, channel, or support. Cannot bring down a load-bearing structure without consequences in the story.
strings.souvislý nemagický kámen do 1 m³: a continuous mass of nonmagical stone up to 1 m³
strings.1 cíl stojící na kameni či půdě: 1 target standing on stone or soil
strings.Při úspěchu se běžný cíl nemůže přesunou: On success, an ordinary target cannot move but can act within reach. A main opponent only takes −2 to its next movement check.
strings.Silný jednobodový zemní útok proti MO cí: A powerful single-target earth attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.Vytvoří překážku s 12 Ž a FO 13, která b: Creates an obstacle with 12 HP and PDEF 13 that blocks movement and sight. When the effect ends, it crumbles safely.
strings.nezvyšuje FO ani MO; zeď má FO 13: does not increase PDEF or MDEF; the wall has PDEF 13
strings.volná linie do 4 m na zemi: an unobstructed line up to 4 m long on the ground
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná s MO každého cíl: One MATK roll is compared with each target's MDEF. A target dealt at least 1 HP of damage also loses its next move, not its entire action.
strings.nejvýše 3 cíle stojící blízko sebe na ze: at most 3 targets standing close together on the ground
strings.1× za dobrodružství; nesčítá se: once per adventure; does not stack
strings.Cíl získá +4 FO, ale jeho vlastní pohyb: The target gains +4 PDEF, but its own movement is halved for the spell's duration.
strings.Pošle cíli jednu krátkou myšlenkovou vět: Sends the target one short mental sentence in the caster's voice. Does not read the target's thoughts.
strings.Pohybuje předmětem libovolným směrem. Po: Moves an item in any direction. If it is thrown at a creature, make one MATK attack with a +1 bonus; Telekinesis then ends.
strings.nejvýše 1 předmět; útok kouzlo ukončí: at most 1 item; an attack ends the spell
strings.předmět do 10 kg a 10 m: an item up to 10 kg within 10 m
strings.1× na stejný cíl za scénu; platí pravidl: once per target per scene; the main-opponent rule applies
strings.Při úspěchu běžný cíl nezaútočí, dokud n: On success, an ordinary target does not attack unless attacked; it can speak, take cover, or retreat. A main opponent instead takes −2 to its next attack.
strings.+0 k MÚ při prohlédnutí: +0 to MATK when the illusion is scrutinized
strings.Vytvoří nehmotný obraz nebo zvuk. Kdo s: Creates an intangible image or sound. Anyone interacting with it directly compares their MDEF with the caster's MATK; a successful defense reveals the illusion.
strings.obraz nebo zvuk v prostoru do 2 m: an image or sound in a space up to 2 m
strings.1× za souboj; pouze proti Mysli; nesčítá: once per combat; only against Mind magic; does not stack
strings.Cíl získá +3 MO proti kouzlům školy Mysl: The target gains +3 MDEF against spells of the Mind school.
strings.1 spojení; cíl musí být na začátku na do: 1 connection; the target must be within sight at the start
strings.Umožní obousměrný přenos krátkých vět a: Allows two-way transmission of short sentences and simple images. Does not read thoughts that are not sent.
